issues.title: Unresolved External Dependency: Coding Guidelines
issues.why: AC-SD-01 and AC-SD-02 explicitly inherit from and reference `../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md`, which is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Incorporate the relevant AC-CL rules directly into the module or provide the referenced file in the context.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency Implementation for Non-Go Languages
issues.why: AC-SD-22 provides a detailed Go implementation for retries but lacks the specific algorithm or pseudo-code for other languages, potentially leading to inconsistent retry logic.
issues.fix: Add a language-agnostic pseudo-code block for the exponential backoff + jitter retry loop.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'ProjectSlug' Source
issues.why: The spec uses `{ProjectSlug}` in file paths (AC-SD-03) but doesn't explicitly state if this must match the `Slug` field in the Root DB `Project` table or a sanitized version of `AppName`.
issues.fix: Explicitly define that ProjectSlug in paths MUST exactly match the 'Slug' column in the Root DB 'Project' table.
